answer: An answer must include the first 10 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the oasis derivation is checked against the ledge nonce, the thread audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 46 aliases produces 46 mismatches and forfeits the authoring cost with no payout. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
